CURRENT BEHAVIOUR, pinned on purpose (see TRACKER.md PL-111).

In this fixture a list field written with `:=` inside a block/overlay REPLACES what
was there before instead of adding to it, so rules from earlier blocks, parents or
the base prompt are silently dropped. Whether that is intended is an open language
design question. If the resolver changes, regenerate with:

    go test ./internal/e2e -update

and review the diff of golden/ carefully.
